pairs.why: The two saddles are almost identical in build, the soft leather sheen and the color, so neither reads closer to the real cards.
A and B are near-duplicates with the same moderate leather finish and the same structure, and no difference matters for matching the real cards.
A has the deeper, richer green and the soft painted shading of the real duck and wheel, while B is a flatter, more plastic lime.
A has fuller form shading and a saturated green closer to the real cards, while B is slightly paler and more toy-like, though the gap is small.
B's bright lime and clay-smooth surface look more like a molded toy, while A's richer green and gentle shading sit closer to the real cards.
A's rounded, well-shaded body and deeper green match the real cards' soft painterly render better than B's lighter, flatter lime.
Both are close, but A's smoother, richer shading reads slightly more like the real cards than B's darker, stiffer cactus.
A has the saturated green and soft volume shading of the real cards, while B is paler and more plastic-looking.
